about: Pretty Women is an online clothing shop whose public Instagram collection includes sweatshirts, knitwear, coordinated casual looks and seasonal jackets. The profile advertises door-to-door delivery and cash on delivery. Customers can ask about pieces and availability through its Instagram account.
